Adstra Online ID Opt-Out

Adstra Opt-out Preferences
Choice Mechanisms

Adstra wants you to be in control of your experience while online. We help our Clients provide you with digital advertising that’s meaningful and supports the Sites you use for free, so everyone wins. We offer two choice mechanisms: an opt-out mechanism as well as the ability to reset your Adstra advertising ID. If you want to exercise choice via either or both mechanisms, please follow the instructions below. To learn more
